title: H.M. Pulham, Esquire by John P Marquand 1941 Hardcover - Little, Brown & Company
descriptionText:
This antique book titled "H.M. Pulham, Esquire" by John P Marquand is a rare find for any literature enthusiast. Published in 1941 by Little Brown & Company, this hardcover book is an original printing that will surely impress collectors. The book is written in English and is a great addition to any book collection.

The book's binding is intact and shows some signs of wear, which is expected given its age. The author's expertise in writing is evident in the well-developed characters and captivating storyline. This book is perfect for those who appreciate classic literature and want to add a valuable piece to their collection.
